description: Delete a monitor for good. Free. A queued run is cancelled and its hold released; its runs and items are no longer readable. This cannot be undone: to stop it for a while, use monitor-update with status 'paused' instead.

monitor_id.description: monitor_id returned by monitor-create or monitor-list, example: '6f1d0c9e-0d55-4b8e-9a3c-3c4d9b8e2a10'.

name: monitor-delete
title: Delete Monitor
